1st [other]Reach Limits[/other]:
Concentrate your power, increasing your [buff]Move Speed[/buff] by [buff]{1}[/buff] while [other]channeling[/other] for up to [other]{0}[/other]. 
Increases all [buff]damage[/buff] you deal by [buff]{2}[/buff] for [buff]{3}[/buff].
Ending the channel enables the next combo ability.

2nd [other]Limitbreaker[/other]:
Swipe your sword twice in a [other]cone in front[/other] of you, dealing [dmg]{4} physical damage[/dmg] with each swipe.
